About Anthropic and the Claude for Open Source Initiative

Anthropic is the AI safety and research company behind the Claude family of AI models. Because modern software development relies heavily on community-maintained libraries, package registries, and foundational infrastructure, Anthropic launched the Claude for Open Source Program as a direct way to thank contributors for the code they ship.

Instead of restricting access strictly to large corporate teams, the program evaluates real-world ecosystem impact across platforms like GitHub, npm, PyPI, crates.io, and RubyGems.

Key Highlights of the Claude Open Source Program 2027

Who Should Apply?

Anthropic outlines five clear contribution categories for applicants. Meeting any one of the following benchmarks qualifies you to apply:

1. Maintainers and Library Authors

You maintain packages that other developers build upon, meeting at least one of these metrics:

Open to all College students any Stream, undergraduate students, graduates, and postgraduates).

500 or more dependent repositories.

100 or more dependent packages.

200,000 or more combined monthly downloads across registries such as npm, PyPI, crates.io, RubyGems, or similar package managers.

2. Core Contributors

You are a listed committer or maintainer on a recognized open-source foundation or programming language project, including:

  • CPython or Rust team
  • Node.js TSC or Apache PMC
  • CNCF, Kubernetes, or the Linux kernel
  • Django, Rails, or similar foundational projects

3. Active Contributors

You have authored 100 or more pull requests merged into repositories you do not own within the last 12 months. This pathway is particularly relevant for college students and individual developers actively contributing bug fixes and features across multiple open-source projects.

4. Community Builders

At least one repository you maintain has attracted 20 or more unique external contributors with merged pull requests over the last 12 months.

5. Critical Infrastructure Maintainers

Any repository you maintain holds an OpenSSF criticality score of 0.4 or above.

What If You Don’t Meet Every Threshold?

Anthropic explicitly welcomes edge-case applications. If your repository does not hit the exact numbers above—but you maintain a tool, library, or dependency that the ecosystem quietly relies on—you are encouraged to apply anyway and explain its impact in the form.

Subscription Benefits and How the 6-Month Plan Works

Approved applicants receive 6 months of complimentary Claude Ultra to support their open-source development workflows.

Before applying, understand how billing works once the six-month term concludes:

Advance Notification: Anthropic sends an email reminder before your 6-month complimentary period expires.

Existing Paid Subscribers: If you held a paid Claude plan prior to joining the program, your account automatically resumes at your previous plan and rate unless you cancel before the period ends.

Free Tier Users: If you did not have a prior paid subscription, your account automatically reverts to the standard free plan with no unexpected charges.
